sandbox.title: Simulator sandbox
sandbox.description: A cobot model in the browser. Drag the sliders to move the joints — the robot follows and stays within its limits.

placeholder6Dof.notice: A training stand-in, not a PROMPOWER model. Its geometry and joint limits are invented and will be replaced once the real URDF arrives.

jaka6Dof.name: JAKA cobot, 6 axes
jaka6Dof.notice: A temporary JAKA model from a public repository, not a PROMPOWER cobot. The geometry and joint limits are real but belong to a different robot; the file will be replaced once the customer supplies the URDF.
